topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the fifth lecture of the series, outlines the learning objectives, and establishes the core themes of cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective advantages that drive clonal expansion and progression.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Cancer Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchy and the differentiation state of the cell of origin influence susceptibility to malignant transformation.

topics.label: The Tumor Microenvironment and Inflammatory Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma cooperate with cellular alterations to permit tumor initiation, plasticity, and maintenance.

topics.label: Methods for Investigating Clonal Evolution and the Microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the experimental, sequencing, and spatial profiling technologies used to investigate tumor heterogeneity and microenvironmental interactions in the lab.

topics.label: Integrated Evolutionary Model of Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the multi-factorial contributions of mutational burden, epigenetics, cell of origin, and microenvironmental conditions into a unified evolutionary framework of cancer progression.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
